messages:
anita_csm: Weekly health check for Peregrine — quick snapshot (p95 / p99) by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. Attaching summary CSV and short notes. https://files.redwood.internal/peregrine_weekly.csv :paperclip:

anita_csm: Highlights:
- Route: /generate-chat (short prompts): streaming p95 ~ 280ms, non-streaming p95 ~ 520ms. streaming p99 ~ 1.1s, non-streaming p99 ~ 3.2s.
- Route: /completion-bulk (long prompts): streaming p95 ~ 1.6s, non-streaming p95 ~ 1.4s (streaming overhead for long sequences), p99 parity ~ 2.9s.
- Model split: rw-xl-13b-quant shows biggest gap on p99 for non-streaming on short prompts (3.8s vs 1.2s). opt-6.7b is stable across modes.
- Error rate uptick on /generate-chat (0.8% -> 1.9%) coincides with p99 spikes; likely circuit breaker hits when non-streaming tails blow up.
- Spend: weekly inference spend +22% MoM driven by retries on /generate-chat non-streaming.

jonas_eng: Thanks — can you paste the per-model table inline? small ask for eng triage.

anita_csm: pasted the trimmed table below (top 3 models by traffic):
```
route,model,stream_p95,stream_p99,nonstream_p95,nonstream_p99
/generate-chat,rw-xl-13b-quant,280ms,1.2s,520ms,3.8s
/generate-chat,opt-6.7b,240ms,950ms,260ms,1.0s
/completion-bulk,rw-xl-13b-quant,1.6s,2.9s,1.4s,2.7s
```

jonas_eng: Ok — rw-xl-13b-quant nonstream p99 is the outlier. Any config differences on the customer Dedicated pool? batching, mem limits? @lee_sre can you check node OOM/restarts? :eyes:

lee_sre: Quick check: no pod restarts in the last 48h, CPU stable. I do see frequent FSD (fast sequential dequeue) churn when non-streaming load bursts hit; KV cache hit-rate for Peregrine is 12% (low). That explains larger tails when cache not helping.

lee_sre: Suggested ops tweak: enable prefix KV caching for /generate-chat and raise per-worker batch size from 8 -> 12 for dedicated pool. Should reduce nonstream p99 by ~30-50%.

maya_pm: Renewal health question — 22% spend bump + higher p99s are customer-visible. Any immediate mitigation before next renewal touch?

anita_csm: Action plan for next 72h:
- Eng (jonas) to validate enable-prefix-cache change and run canary on 2 workers (ETA 18h).
- SRE (lee) to increase batch size and monitor p95/p99 (ETA 6h).
- CS (anita) to start proactive customer note summarizing mitigations + ask for short test prompts to validate UX (ETA 24h).

jonas_eng: I'll roll the cache flag behind feature flag and run the canary. Query I will use to validate tail:
```
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95,
       percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
FROM request_logs
WHERE account = 'peregrine' AND route = '/generate-chat' AND model = 'rw-xl-13b-quant' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

anita_csm: Customer note draft (short): "We observed intermittent p99 spikes on /generate-chat for rw-xl-13b-quant. We're enabling prefix caching + tuning batching right away. We'll follow up with a short validation script and a final report. No action required on your side unless you see functional regressions." Thoughts?

maya_pm: FYI include cost impact line: "Expected ~8-12% unit cost reduction if canary validated" — helps renewal conversation.

lee_sre: I'll watch the error-rate mapping after batch change. If errors spike, we'll rollback immediately. opsbot: create incident-free alert for p99 > 2s on /generate-chat for peregrine.

opsbot: Alert created — ID: ALRT-2026-1098 — threshold p99 > 2000ms on route /generate-chat for account peregrine. Owner: lee_sre.

anita_csm: Thanks team. I'll update Peregrine today and add this to their renewal worksheet. Next check-in Fri 10:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
